decks.notes: The Golgari Garden deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board through removal spells like Cast Down and Defile, while also gaining value through sacrificing creatures and generating card advantage with spells like Deadly Dispute and Ichor Wellspring. The deck also aims to outvalue the opponent with card draw effects like Lembas and Avenging Hunter, while maintaining a strong board presence with creatures like Crypt Rats and Troll of Khazad-dûm. The deck's strategy revolves around resource management and disrupting the opponent's game plan while gradually building up to a winning position.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, efficient white creatures. By utilizing cards like Squadron Hawk and Thraben Inspector to generate card advantage and Kor Skyfisher to reuse valuable resources, this deck aims to maintain a fast pace and apply consistent pressure. Cards like Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech provide additional ways to increase the deck's aggression, while removal spells like Journey to Nowhere help control the board and clear a path for the weenie creatures to attack.

The deck focuses on quickly playing a large number of artifacts onto the battlefield to power up creatures with All That Glitters and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. With cards like Myr Enforcer, Frogmite, and Gingerbrute, the deck can quickly establish a strong board presence. Springleaf Drum helps to ramp out creatures early on, while Galvanic Blast offers direct damage to remove threats. Additionally, Thoughtcast provides card draw to keep the deck running smoothly. The Affinity mechanic is key to this deck's strategy, allowing for explosive plays that can quickly end the game.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Tireless Tribe combo, using cards like Inside Out and Whiteout to pump up the Tribe's power and toughness to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Escape Tunnel and Prismatic Strands to protect the Tribe and ensure its survival. Additionally, the deck includes some card draw and control elements like Brainstorm and Dispel to maintain card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful attack.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, efficient creatures and powerful spells. By focusing on aggressive creatures like Novice Inspectors, Thraben Inspectors, and Kor Skyfishers, along with buffing them with cards like All That Glitters and Lembas, the deck aims to deal quick and heavy damage to the opponent. In addition, the deck includes versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to efficiently deal with opposing threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes cards like Boros Garrison and Great Furnace to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing gates and controlling the game with counterspells and removal spells. By using cards like Journey to Nowhere and Counterspell, the goal is to maintain board control while generating card advantage with Squadron Hawk. The inclusion of Dawnbringer Cleric and Guardian of the Guildpact offers additional protection and stability against aggressive strategies. The deck also incorporates some card draw and protection spells to outlast opponents in longer matches. With a mix of efficient removal and resilient threats, this deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through attrition.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Wild Growth, and then disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Thermokarst and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss. This allows you to play large threats like Avenging Hunter, Boarding Party, Generous Ent, and Annoyed Altisaur early in the game to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. Llanowar Visionary and Crimson Fleet Commodore provide additional versatility and card advantage to keep the aggression going.

The focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly play low-cost creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and bounce spells. By efficiently controlling the board and drawing cards to maintain pressure, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game through tempo advantage. Utilizing evasion and card advantage, the deck seeks to capitalize on the opponent's misplays and secure victory through early aggression and disruptive tactics.

The main idea of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly play low-cost creatures and spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. By utilizing cards like Alms of the Vein, Fiery Temper, and Lightning Bolt, along with aggressive creatures like Kitchen Imp and Voldaren Epicure, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. The deck also includes cards like Deadly Dispute and Highway Robbery to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck utilizes artifact lands like Drossforge Bridge and Vault of Whispers to help fix mana and enable Metalcraft for cards like Galvanic Blast.

The deck focuses on controlling the board using cards like Snap and Ephemerate to bounce opponents' creatures and continually generate card advantage with Mulldrifter. The God-Pharaoh's Faithful provide early defense while Sunscape Familiar reduces the cost of spells. Archaeomancer helps recur valuable instants and sorceries while Preordain and The Modern Age help dig for answers. The deck also includes some protection and disruption with Prohibit, Remove Soul, and Prismatic Strands. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue and outlast opponents through careful resource management and timely interaction.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with low-cost artifacts and efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher. Utilizing burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt help control the board and clear a path for creatures to attack. All That Glitters provides a power boost to creatures equipped with artifacts, while cards like Lembas and Wedding Invitation can provide additional creature buffs. With a mix of card draw and artifact recursion, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to use walls that tap for mana to generate a lot of mana, then use that mana to play combo pieces such as Freed from the Real and Galvanic Alchemist to create an infinite mana loop. Once the loop is established, the player can win the game by playing Reaping the Graves to bring back all their combo pieces and finish off the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Winding Way and Lead the Stampede to help find combo pieces and keep the engine running smoothly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy cheap creatures and disruption spells to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. By utilizing efficient card draw and low-cost counterspells, the deck aims to maintain tempo and control of the game. The aggressive nature of the Mono Blue Aggro archetype allows for quick threats to be put on the board, forcing the opponent to react and potentially fall behind in the race. The inclusion of cards like Tolarian Terror and Cryptic Serpent provide additional threats that can end games quickly if left unchecked.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a strong, evasive creature with powerful auras to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing creatures like Gladecover Scout and Slippery Bogle along with auras like Ethereal Armor and Ancestral Mask, the goal is to create a threat that is difficult for the opponent to deal with efficiently. The deck also includes cards like Cartouche of Solidarity and Spirit Link to further enhance the creature's capabilities. Additionally, Abundant Growth and Utopia Sprawl help with mana fixing and ramping up to cast bigger auras faster.

The deck focuses on using graveyard recursion and sacrificing creatures to bring back powerful creatures like Lotleth Giant and Troll of Khazad-dûm early in the game. It utilizes cards like Dread Return and Exhume to reanimate creatures from the graveyard, while also generating value with cards like Stinkweed Imp and Satyr Wayfinder. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a big board presence, with the ability to repeatedly bring back threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this UR Control deck is to control the board through counterspells and removal spells, while also generating value through card draw and token generation. Cards like Counterspell, Lightning Bolt, and Skred help to efficiently deal with threats, while cards like Murmuring Mystic, Lórien Revealed, and Tolarian Terror provide additional win conditions and defense. Augur of Bolas and Brainstorm help dig for specific answers, while Azure Fleet Admiral and Crimson Fleet Commodore provide additional threats and pressure. Overall, the deck focuses on outlasting opponents and winning through card advantage and incremental advantage.
